name: Destination: Nowhere
source:
You see the story through the eyes of 'Mary', a young woman that has boarded the Dawnward-Express.
'Mary' enters the train with both emotional and physical baggage, fighting through the reluctance of interacting with any human beings for one clear goal: Going for a smoke.
She will meat, uh meet* other girls on the train, all as uneducated on the meaning of the train and with their personal issues.
This demo focuses on just one girl, friendly and cheerful on the outside, gnawing at 'Mary's desire of digging deeper into a woman's broken self.

[From [url=https://eeeveeva.itch.io/destination-nowhere]itch.io[/url]]
